summary: American Rebel Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing two October 14, 2026 exchange agreements with existing holders rather than a special situation. Horberg exchanged 6,800 Series D preferred shares ($51,000) into 51 Series E shares, then those 51 Series E shares into 1,104,853 common shares; Streeterville partitioned a $65,000 secured note from its $5.47 million June 2025 note and swapped it for 990,853 common shares. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. These are debt/equity conversions by existing counterparties, creating share overhang; watch dilution and any related Hinterland financing terms.
